body.text: A channel message to a busy Claude is queued: ~0.2 s after the write its transcript holds an exact queue-operation enqueue record, and a message absorbed mid-turn never gets a user record, so the send waited 30 s and exited 1 (DELIVERY UNCONFIRMED) although it had arrived. receipt_seen now accepts that enqueue record when it is after the snapshot, in the same session, and its content passes the existing exact channel_receipt check (source, message_id, body digest, body). Written with neither enqueue nor user record still exits 1. Tests: linked PR from test/msg-u14-channel-queue.

title.text: AGENT-MESSAGE-SUBMIT U14 product: a busy Claude's channel enqueue is the receipt
